items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Pichu, well I knew him, but I'd have left his bum with him because he played piano nicely.

ctx.x: I think I know a guy named Pelabon down there.
What the hell? Lawrence and all of them when he was living with them. He was well known for 27th. And Pichu, well I knew him, but I'd have left his bum with him because he played piano nicely.
